facts.fact: TanzaniaInvest reports that several municipal and district councils, along with the Dodoma, Arusha, Tanga, Mbeya and Mwanza regions, have started using the Ministry of Lands' national e-Ardhi land platform; no count of councils is given and the date is the document's published date.

The document says only that 'several' municipal and district councils have started using the national e-Ardhi platform, with no number and no total of councils; the date is the document's published date.
